Each tile is a flat orthographic FULL-BLEED MATERIAL, no perspective, no objects shown in a room, no blank backgrounds. Refined hand-painted pixel-art look, crisp detailed antique mahogany, old gold, rich burgundy and cream; evenly lit albedo without directional cast shadows. Each tile fills its entire square.
Tile grid, left to right, top to bottom:
Row 1: (1) rich burgundy silk quilt fabric with subtle repeating gold damask motifs, no border; (2) ivory mattress ticking woven cloth, subtle thin vertical beige stripes; (3) ivory pillow silk with gentle padded fabric folds, no object silhouette or background; (4) burgundy bed-curtain velvet with long vertical pleats.

Row 4: (1) carved mahogany canopy fascia with golden repeating acanthus scrolls; (2) dark mahogany end-grain cross sections, flat wood material; (3) burgundy textile with horizontal embroidered gold hem along bottom edge for bedspread sides; (4) dark woven burgundy cloth backing for undersides.
These are sixteen usable full-bleed texture swatches with clean boundaries at exact quarter coordinates. No text, no labels, no watermark, no diagram lines, no transparent pixels, no lighting gradient across sheet.
